insight.title: Why You Say Yes to Favors You Don’t Want to Do
insight.subtitle: How to stop filling your future schedule with tasks you’ll regret.

sections.text: We often agree to a commitment for next week that we would reject if it were happening in ten minutes. We treat our future time as if it were an infinite, free resource.
Your brain views your "future self" as a stranger. Since you don’t feel the immediate stress of the task, you prioritize short-term social ease over the reality of your actual workload and energy.
This habit creates a calendar full of obligations you never truly wanted. You trade your long-term focus for a fleeting moment of politeness, leaving your future self to pay for your past decisions.
The next time you receive a request today, ask if you would say yes for this afternoon.

news.title: Iran conflict fuels biggest monthly inflation spike in 4 years as CPI hits 3.3%
news.description: American consumers are feeling the sting of higher prices after the biggest monthly inflation spike in four years.
news.why: Your grocery and gas bills are rising due to this inflation surge.

news.title: Treasuries Fall as Inflation Data Erode Fed Rate-Cut Wager
news.description: Treasuries fell as quickening inflation stemming from the US war on Iran — and the prospect of escalation — eroded wagers that the Federal Reserve will lower interest rates once this year.
news.why: High interest rates keep your monthly mortgage and car loan payments expensive.

news.title: Vance heads to Islamabad; Iran demands measures as 'make-or-break' talks near
news.description: U.S. Vice President JD Vance departed on Friday for "make-or-break" negotiations with Iran, even as Tehran insisted on measures before peace talks could take place, throwing last-minute doubt over the meetings scheduled in Pakistan. President Donald Trump announced ‌a two-week ceasefire in the six-week war on Tuesday, just hours before…
news.why: Escalating conflict risks disrupting global shipping routes and your flight schedules.

news.title: Trump’s AI Chip Export Push Stymied by Bureaucratic Bottleneck
news.description: President Donald Trump’s goal of significantly boosting global sales of American AI chips risks being undermined by licensing bottlenecks, staffing attrition and a lack of policy direction at the federal agency that oversees exports of billions of dollars in sensitive US technology.
news.why: Trade bottlenecks will likely limit your choice of high-end consumer electronics.

news.title: Early souring of an AI dream
news.description: AI threatens service jobs globally; India’s BPO-led growth model faces rising disruption, weak investment signals and policy gaps| India News
news.why: Automation is changing hiring, making entry-level service jobs harder to find.

news.title: TSMC posts record revenue as AI chip demand stays strong
news.description: TSMC is benefiting from sustained demand for advanced semiconductors from its key customers like Apple and Nvidia.
news.why: Steady chip production ensures new smartphones and tablets remain in stock.

news.title: Amazon CEO reveals AI revenue, dismisses spending doubts in annual letter
news.description: AMAZON’S AI services at its cloud-computing unit are generating annualized revenue of more than $15 billion, CEO Andy Jassy said, the first time the company has reported numbers on a business it has backed with billions of dollars in investment.
news.why: Amazon's AI investments help you find the right products more quickly.

news.title: Amazon Leo satellite internet is nearing launch, and it already has big customers to rival Starlink
news.description: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy says the company’s long-awaited Leo satellite internet service is finally set to launch in mid-2026, with enterprise and government customers already signed on.
news.why: Satellite competition will soon give you more choices for high-speed home internet.

news.title: Anthropic Eyes Custom AI Chip Design as Claude's Demand Hits New Highs
news.description: Anthropic is weighing a move into custom AI chip design as demand for its Claude model surges past a $30 billion revenue run rate in 2026, amid industry-wide chip shortages, massive cloud deals by Meta, and new cybersecurity push Project Glasswing.
news.why: Custom chips will make your favorite AI apps respond much faster.

news.title: Elon Musk's xAI sues Colorado over state's new AI law
news.description: The lawsuit cites White House executive orders criticizing state-by-state AI regulation and federal warnings that patchwork state laws could undermine US AI leadership and national security.
news.why: These legal challenges determine how your personal information is used by AI.

news.title: South Africa unveils draft AI policy, proposes new institutions and incentives
news.description: The AI policy, published by the Department of Communications and Digital Technologies, aims to position ‌South Africa ⁠as ⁠a continental leader in AI innovation while addressing ethical, social ​and economic challenges.
news.why: New policy frameworks will create more tech training opportunities for your career.
